headline: Britannia's cottages have substance; the PLAICRAFT lag shape is gated
lede: Every gate-town in BRITANNIA now has seeded cottages you can walk up to and be refused at — a timber knock, a named door, ink that matches the physics. On the harness side, the audited clap-lag shape (slow CPU plus a late microphone) is now provable in a can-fail gate rather than a paragraph.

notes.text: BRITANNIA #2497 (3a7edb1): 36 cottages across all 8 towns, barred-door refusal with its own knock, draw==block, cottage-drive 6/6 with a deterministic named knock; britanniacheck 374 green incl. two red mutants.
PLAICRAFT #2493 (9e7a4e7): plaicraft-clap gains --micdelay/--lag-min and an achieved-lag report; late-mic shape proven at -3.9s, can-fail red at -1s; #1711 released to humans.
Filed #2499 for the QA lane: Britannia polish pass — door glyphs, chimney smoke, night lamps, per-gate town names, stone footsteps.

Catch of the shift: the Britannia gate wheel is a 3x3 zone — after a teleport the first step re-opens the menu, which freezes the walk clock and eats arrows; drives must dismiss Z mid-hold. And Report.check takes the label first — swapped args pass vacuously.
